content.outcome: Make the public repository shell, verification contract, and GitHub operating posture explicit and verifiable without introducing hand-authored documentation authority.

classification.reason: The change affects public onboarding/security surfaces, PR verification, and repository settings but preserves canonical Governance and Work Management semantics.

authority_model: publication/public-repository.json owns public-repository presentation/configuration facts introduced by this change.
README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, and the pull-request template are deterministic generated projections and MUST NOT become write-back authority.
AGENTS.md remains repository execution authority; canonical domain MRDs remain semantic authority.
GitHub settings observed through the registered provider remain external operational state and are not inferred from repository files.
requirements: R1: Public onboarding, contribution, vulnerability-reporting, ownership, dependency-update, and PR-evidence surfaces MUST be present.
R2: Generated Markdown public surfaces MUST be byte-verifiable from machine-readable configuration.
R3: Canonical verification MUST require PowerShell 7+, public hygiene validation, generated-surface freshness, and full PR Git history for completion-keyword detection.
R4: Main MUST remain protected with exact `verify` CI evidence and KIS-governed merge behavior.
R5: Public visibility MUST NOT be represented as an open-source license grant when no project-wide license exists.
implementation_plan: P1: Reconstruct the omitted Change 019 record from immutable Git/GitHub evidence.
P2: Compare repository/public GitHub posture against commodity and ChatGPT-skill.
P3: Add machine-readable public-repository configuration and deterministic public surface generation.
P4: Add CODEOWNERS, Dependabot, PR template, hygiene validation, and explicit PowerShell 7 runtime contract.
P5: Run focused and canonical verification, review, publish, merge, and reconcile Work Management.
justified_deviations: No project-wide LICENSE file is added because both references explicitly preserve a no-open-source-grant posture and the operator did not authorize a license grant.

Merged remote branches are retained because the registered KIS repository policy sets delete_branch_on_merge=false; branch retention is therefore governance behavior rather than a public-readiness defect.
Public Markdown surfaces are generated instead of hand-authored because kis-mcp-doc forbids parallel hand-authored Markdown truth.
verification_criteria: V1: Focused public-repository and Windows-runtime tests pass.
V2: Full scripts/verify.ps1 passes without mutating tracked state.
V3: Generated public surfaces reproduce byte-for-byte from publication/public-repository.json.
V4: GitHub main is protected and PR-context verify succeeds on the exact head.
V5: Work item #3 is reconciled only after merge and post-merge evidence.

tasks.text: Compare public repository posture against commodity and ChatGPT-skill.
Implement deterministic public surfaces, hygiene controls, CI hardening, and GitHub repository alignment.
Verify, review, publish, merge, and reconcile closeout.

risks: Generated root Markdown can be mistaken for hand-authored authority; byte verification and explicit authority text prevent that role reversal.
PR completion-keyword scanning requires full Git history; CI checkout is explicitly changed to fetch-depth 0.
Repository-provider settings can drift independently of Git; final closeout re-observes live GitHub state.
explicit_exclusions: Changing canonical Governance or Work Management semantics.
Deleting KIS-retained historical remote branches merely for cosmetic cleanup.
